note: boot2-fix-failures v2 (augment of v1): v1's log shows MemberController.java untouched ('not found', the argument is `http`) → rename the call on every reported line whatever the argument — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|clientIp` (8bb4fd4a4a)
response:
<analysis>v1 only matched the call with the argument `request`; MemberController calls clientIp(http), so its error stayed. The new version renames clientIp( to remoteClientIp( on every reported error line, independent of the argument, and leaves other clientIp names (the CLIENT_IP_ATTRIBUTE constant) alone.</analysis>
<script>
import re

CALL = re.compile(r"\bclientIp\(")


def fix(p):
    lines_by_file = {}
    for e in p.errors:
        if e.get("file") and e.get("line") and p.exists(e["file"]):
            lines_by_file.setdefault(e["file"], set()).add(int(e["line"]))
    for path, lines in sorted(lines_by_file.items()):
        rows = p.read(path).split("\n")
        changed = 0
        for ln in sorted(lines):
            if 0 < ln <= len(rows) and CALL.search(rows[ln - 1]):
                rows[ln - 1] = CALL.sub("remoteClientIp(", rows[ln - 1])
                changed += 1
        if changed:
            p.write(path, "\n".join(rows))
        p.log(f"{path}: clientIp( -> remoteClientIp( on {changed} reported line(s)")
</script>
